activity.notes: Sir Edward Patrick Morris served as Prime Minister of the Dominion of Newfoundland from 2 March 1909 through 31 December 1917. He was later created Baron Morris in 1918; ATLAS uses the stable biographical canonical name while recording the office and polity appropriate to his premiership.
